name: Digital China Holdings Limited
summary: Digital China Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding entity primarily delivering advanced big data solutions and products to government bodies and corporate clients across Mainland China. Its core Big Data Products and Solutions division specializes in data software emphasizing spatial-temporal big data and artificial intelligence. Key offerings within this segment include a sophisticated data fabric – notably Yan Cloud DaaS, a platform facilitating data sharing, interoperability, and the seamless integration of disparate digital systems, alongside Sysnet, which unifies diverse data, applications, and services. The division also furnishes data hub products covering management, security, innovation, and aggregation, alongside digital twin technology for creating virtual representations of urban environments. Furthermore, it develops data-driven solutions for the digital transformation of cities and supply chains, as well as for the fintech sector. The Software and Operating Services segment delivers comprehensive, data-driven supply chain management services, in addition to full lifecycle software services encompassing development, testing, operations, and maintenance. Its Traditional Services division encompasses systems integration, e-commerce supply chain solutions, and software and operational support. This segment also diversifies into investments, property sales, and rental activities. Beyond these main segments, the company is involved in a broad spectrum of services, including logistics, technical support, network optimization, rural agricultural internet initiatives, data processing, manpower outsourcing, and cloud application systems. It undertakes the development of science and technology parks, finance leasing, and property development projects, and manages a 'smart city' platform. The company also distributes specialized financial equipment and surveying software. Furthermore, Digital China Holdings provides advanced biometric access control solutions such as the touchless multi-biometric reader Quattro and the contactless Aibion Trio. Established in 2000, Digital China Holdings Limited maintains its headquarters in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
